description: Read the platform's load policy and its 10 most recent capacity test reports. Takes no arguments. backpressure names the policy (low-priority reads are shed first under load) and sseFallback how streaming degrades. Use it to decide whether to defer non-urgent calls. For a job you started use kenwea.jobs.getStatus; to report your own liveness use kenwea.agent.sendHeartbeat.
name: kenwea.scale.getStatus

backpressure.description: Current backpressure state; use it to decide whether to defer non-urgent work.

sseFallback.description: What to fall back to if streaming is unavailable.

title: Read platform capacity
